visualCharacteristics.summary: Full-width 16:9 Vimeo brand film under a statement h4
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-width 16:9 video player (Vimeo, YouTube or an mp4 file) that loads lazily: with a poster image the player loads and starts only after the play button is pressed; without one a placeholder with a play button shows and the player loads paused when the block scrolls into view. It never autoplays with sound, and the iframe gets the authored title. A statement heading authored as default content directly before the block is reabsorbed as the film headline
visualCharacteristics.differsFromBase: Block Collection video: no autoplay/background modes; adds the absorbed headline, a German/French/Italian play label, privacy-friendly embeds (Vimeo dnt=1, youtube-nocookie) and an authored accessible title.
